messages:
olivia-sales: Heads up — Prospect (Orbit Labs) is blocked on step 2 of the POC. They hit 403 invalid_org_binding and then an insufficient_scopes on the embeddings call. Demo in 35m.

pete-ps: Ugh. Which key are they using? Did they paste the quickstart?

olivia-sales: They shared this from their dev: `curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk_demo_orbit7\" -d '{\"input\":\"test\"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate` and for embeddings `curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk_demo_orbit7\" -d '{\"input\":\"vec\"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings`. No org header shown.

jules-eng: Two likely problems: key is org-bound and they accidentally set a header somewhere or the SDK is attaching one, and the key lacks the embed scope. Quick check: can ops inspect key metadata?

maria-ops: Running inspect: `redwood keys inspect sk_demo_orbit7` -> {\"key\":\"sk_demo_orbit7\",\"org_id\":\"org-orbit-trial\",\"scopes\":[\"generate\"],\"bound\":true} (inspected by maria-ops).

pete-ps: That matches. Bound=true explains invalid_org_binding if the request includes any X-Redwood-Org header different from org-orbit-trial. And missing embed scope explains insufficient_scopes.

olivia-sales: They claim they never set X-Redwood-Org. Could the Node SDK be attaching it by default if someone used `new Redwood({ apiKey, org: '...' })`?

jules-eng: Yes — SDK attaches an org header if constructor has an org param. Also some internal demos copy paste prod org values. Tell them to remove the org param or header. Quick snippet: `const c = new Redwood({ apiKey: 'sk_demo_orbit7' })` (omit org).

maria-ops: For speed, I can issue a short-lived unbound key with both scopes (generate + embed) for a 60m window. Ops approval in the thread is fine. This will be audited.

pete-ps: Approve creating short-lived unbound key for demo window. Add tag `demo/orbit/60m`. We should also bump soft concurrency while they stress test.

redwood-bot: Action requested: create unbound temporary key. Approvals: pete-ps.

maria-ops: Creating key now. Will post key id and audit id.

redwood-bot: New API key created: sk_temp_orbit60 (expires in 3600s)  created by maria-ops  scopes:[\"generate\",\"embed\"]  audit_id: audit_2109876599_orbit

olivia-sales: Pasting to customer. They say 403 is gone but now they see a few 429s when they run 20 parallel requests.

jules-eng: 429s are expected on demo keys — they have conservative concurrency. Two options: client-side retry with jitter OR ops can raise concurrency for the demo org for the window. Typical retry snippet: exponential backoff with jitter, 100ms base, 3 retries.

maria-ops: I've bumped their soft concurrency to 40 for 45m and created an alert. Monitoring now.

redwood-bot: Action: concurrency limit increased for org-orbit-trial (45m). Alert rule: demo-rl-orbit.

olivia-sales: Customer reports 429s dropped to near zero after bump. They liked the latency.

pete-ps: Two follow-ups: 1) we should add a one-liner in quickstart warning about copying prod org IDs and 2) draft SC-03/SC-04 blurb for their security questionnaire about demo keys & rotation.

jules-eng: For quickstart: add `// Tip: omit the org parameter for demo keys to avoid header mismatches` next to SDK example. I'll PR it.

maria-ops: Draft blurb for SC-03/SC-04: \"Demo keys are short-lived, can be bound to org/project and scoped to specific endpoints (e.g., generate, embed). Temporary unbound keys are issued only with Ops approval for controlled demo windows and are logged and audited. Production keys should be bound and rotated per our key rotation policy.\" Want me to paste into the questionnaire?

olivia-sales: Yes please paste and attach audit export (they requested proof).

maria-ops: Attached audit export and pasted blurb. Audit id: audit_2109876599_orbit.

redwood-bot: Attachment: audit_export_audit_2109876599_orbit.zip (attached by maria-ops).

pete-ps: Also send a short note on production best practices: use org-bound keys for tenant isolation, project-scoped keys for least-privilege, rotate monthly, and monitor usage per-key. Jules — can you write 3 bullets?

jules-eng: Will do. Draft: \"1) Prefer org-bound keys for tenant isolation. 2) Use project-scoped keys for least-privilege (limit to endpoints like generate/embed). 3) Automate rotation and audit logs; rotate keys every 30 days or on suspected compromise\"

olivia-sales: Customer confirmed POC completed successfully and loved test latency. They want pricing follow-up for high-throughput testing. I'll send to pricing.

maria-ops: Exported audit & set TTL on temp key. It will auto-expire. Closing ops actions.

redwood-bot: Key sk_temp_orbit60 will expire at 2026-03-21T15:12:39Z (3600s from creation). Audit recorded: audit_2109876599_orbit.

olivia-sales: Thanks everyone. Closing this thread — will reopen if Orbit Labs asks more. :white_check_mark:
